Randomly suppress activations during training.

Applies inverted dropout during training and passes values through unchanged during evaluation.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Regularization](../categories/regularization.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | dropout, regularization |

## Settings

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Regularization | Drop Probability | `rate` | Number | `0.5` | `0.0-1.0` | The run | Probability of dropping each activation. Required. |

## Usage

```text
Disabled during inference (model.eval()).
```

## Tips

- 0.2-0.5 is typical for Dense layers.
- Use after Dense or before output layer.
